objective: Review exactly the 42 WP-G3-CORR-017 unresolved robot-bowl contexts, freeze a minimal user-decision candidate set, enumerate risks and counterexamples, and define a shared-adapter implementation gate without selecting or changing a runtime safety policy.

authoritative_inputs.role: shared vocabulary, current-semantics projections, and 42-cell authority gap
zero-safety-failure promotion requirement and evaluator-state boundary
scripted stage, selected-bowl, active-side, and safety inputs
ACT G3 pair-label-only safety interface and adapter capability boundary

unresolved_equivalence_classes.pattern: selected bowl, nonclamp robot geometry, every stage and collider class
nonselected bowl, clamp, place or release, inactive or unknown side, every collider class
nonselected bowl, active clamp, retreat, every collider class
nonselected bowl, clamp, retreat, inactive or unknown side, every collider class
nonselected bowl, clamp, other stage, active, inactive, or unknown side, every collider class

candidate_set.name: strict_consensus_fail_closed
candidate_set.rule: Preserve all 54 agreed cells and classify every WP-017 unresolved cell as forbidden.
candidate_set.benefit: Adds no new allowed collision context and is maximally fail-closed.
candidate_set.risk: Preserves the seed-1630 release-to-retreat stage-boundary rejection even when the exact pair is already cached before retreat.
candidate_set.adapter_requirement: Requires stage, selected-bowl, and active-side context; current ACT G3 does not provide these fields.

candidate_set.name: act_equivalent_clamp_only
candidate_set.rule: Forbid every nonclamp robot-bowl pair and allow every clamp robot-bowl pair regardless of stage, selectedness, side, or collider class.
candidate_set.benefit: Can be classified from pair labels alone and matches the current ACT G3 rule.
candidate_set.risk: Broadly allows 30 previously disputed nonselected-bowl clamp contexts, including inactive, unknown-side, retreat, and other-stage contacts.
candidate_set.adapter_requirement: Only robot-geometry classification is required; both executors can obtain it from pair labels.

candidate_set.name: minimum_evidence_gated_release_continuity
candidate_set.rule: Forbid 39 unresolved cells. For the three nonselected active-clamp retreat cells, allow only when the exact pair is proven present in the immediately preceding completed release cache; otherwise forbid.
candidate_set.benefit: Targets the smallest observed stage-boundary ambiguity without granting inactive-side, unknown-side, other-stage, or selected-nonclamp exceptions.
candidate_set.risk: Adds a new continuity-state input supported by only one seed; exact cache provenance and stage transition must be standardized before implementation.
candidate_set.adapter_requirement: Requires stage, selected-bowl, active-side, exact pair identity, and previous-release cache state; neither runtime currently exposes one shared production adapter for all fields.
candidate_set.recommendation_boundary: Recommended only as the least unsupported design direction, not as an authorized runtime policy.

rejected_shortcuts.reason: Collider-name-specific authority would couple policy to one geometry label and overfit one observed pair without an authorized geometry or safety review.

rejected_shortcuts.shortcut: allow for a numeric retreat grace window
rejected_shortcuts.reason: No duration or penetration threshold is authorized or supported by the existing one-seed evidence.

rejected_shortcuts.shortcut: infer ACT task stage from policy step or bowl pose
rejected_shortcuts.reason: The task pack does not define such an inference and it would introduce a new privileged state estimator.

risk_counterexample_matrix.evidence: exact pair present in release cache and persists into retreat
no task authority for expected contact
scripted skip masks geometry while ACT forbids
stage meaning and expected contact role unspecified

common_requirements: one explicit versioned policy identifier selected by the user
one shared raw-pair parser with deterministic pair-order normalization
identical normalized context and decision evidence from scripted and ACT adapters
fail-closed handling of malformed labels and unavailable required context
static 96-cell parity and adapter round-trip tests before any runtime execution
additional_missing_for_continuity_candid: versioned exact-pair cache identity across release-to-retreat transition
authoritative release-transition event in the ACT runtime

downstream_blocked: collection, export, training, inference, or publication

acceptance_matrix.expected: Every authoritative and predecessor hash matches.
Exactly 42 WP-017 unresolved contexts are reviewed and the 54 agreed contexts are not revised.
Candidate A is 42 forbid; B is 30 allow and 12 forbid; C is 39 forbid and 3 conditional.
Seed-1630 continuity, new-retreat contact, inactive/unknown place-release, selected nonclamp, and other-stage cases are explicit.
ACT context deficits and per-candidate static feasibility are fail-closed and reproducible.
No candidate is marked selected; neither runtime executor nor any controller, safety, threshold, geometry, timing, asset, data, or training source changes.
Focused tests pass; all functional regressions pass; only the two immutable predecessor source-pin sentinels fail as expected.
A fresh no-overwrite terminal receipt and SHA-256 manifest verify.

claim_boundary: This local review may classify the 42 existing semantic divergences into equivalence classes, define user-decision candidates, rank risks, and freeze a future adapter implementation gate. It cannot select the authoritative runtime policy, modify either executor, validate safety behavior dynamically, infer an ACT task stage, establish a numeric grace rule, prove the release-tail physical mechanism, establish G3 passage, authorize collection or training, establish AMD/ROCm behavior, validate hardware safety, or authorize publication.
